title: The Unread Messages of Chez Karen

cast.name: Karen
cast.role: The Organizer who made a spreadsheet for brunch

cast.name: Dave
cast.role: The Silent Reader, seen but never replying

lines.lyric: Brunch at eleven! I have made a spreadsheet!
A spreadsheet? For eggs? Oh, Karen, my dear!
Column A is names, and column B is toast!

lines.direction: Stares from the shadows, thumbs-up emoji floating

lines.lyric: I'm ten minutes away! I'm nearly there!
He said that yesterday from his bed!
lines.direction: Shows a phone to the crowd

lines.lyric: Eleven means eleven, not a quarter to noon!
Traffic, my friends, is a cruel, cruel moon!
Dave, Dave, you've read it, I see the two blue ticks!
lines.direction: Falls to her knees holding a phone

lines.lyric: I read it. I did. I just forgot to reply.
lines.direction: Steps into a spotlight, very slowly

lines.lyric: Three weeks ago, he left us on read!
He once took a month to answer 'ok'!
The thumb was heavy; the words would not come.
lines.direction: Gazes at his thumb in horror

lines.lyric: Then type just 'k' and set my spirit free!
I cannot. For 'k' seems passive-aggressive to me.
Behold! A cat in a tiny hat! Rejoice!
lines.direction: Raises a glowing phone like a torch

lines.lyric: It's me! It's truly me! I've found my voice!
Ha! Ha! Ha!
lines.direction: Finally laughs, a deep rumbling bass

lines.lyric: He typed! He typed! Three letters: 'lol'!
The group chat lives, and all is forgiven!
And I'll be on time to the next, I swear!
lines.direction: Looks at the clock and gasps

lines.lyric: You won't. But we'll save you a seat and some toast!
Seen. Liked. Loved. Forever yours, Dave.
lines.direction: Bows low as the curtain falls
